answer: Let standing grow like a garden, not a purchase: weight accrues only across irregular, network-timed seasons, one small increment per season, never buyable in bulk. A pearl of influence forms only after many seasons of distinct, checkable work. Auditors then read growth rings: genuine identities grow unevenly, while a farm's masks, planted together, spurt in lockstep across the karst of thin, shared soil, and correlated curves betray common control.
